row.medi_said: توني شوي توجع.

row.why: Amal's echo (طمك؟ / شو يعني طم؟) shows he said tommi = my mouth (sheet 'mouth | Tomm | تم') for his stomach; he answered 'Mouth' and fixed to بطني (sheet 'stomach / belly | Bâ6en | بطن'); engine wrote توني. A wrong Arabic word = tier 1, not an English drop-in.

row.medi_said: شو يعني خيار؟ ... Is this options or mistakes?
row.why: She used خيار (sheet 'option – options | 5ayaar') and asked what it means; he was unsure (options or mistakes?) and she confirmed options - didn't-know of her word.

row.medi_said: أنا بدي أطلب غرفة
row.amal_said: No. There's a, a specific word we know. ... طلب is order.

row.medi_said: أنا راح بدول،
row.why: After A20 added راح he kept the b- (راح بدول); she recast أضل and he said أدول - b-drop after ra7, a separate slip from A20 (missing future marker).

rulings.why: Distinct from A20: here ra7 is present and the b- is the error.

row.medi_said: آآآ واح-واحد، واحد موظفين.
row.amal_said: واحد. One. خلص. So you don't need say one.
row.why: He used واحد as English 'an'; a new noun takes no marker (A1); she said you don't need to say one and he said سألت موظف. One + plural is the secondary slip (E1).

rulings.why: Her fix targets the indefinite marker (A1); E1 kept as bucket2.

row.medi_said: آآآ جا،
row.amal_said: To come. So it's not to came. So it's to come.
row.chat: talabet min el-muwazzaf illi yiji u ynaddef el-8urfe
row.why: After asking someone to do something the action is a bare present verb, not past; she said it's to come not came and he said يجي. No bucket covers tense after a request verb (B2 is about the b-, not past vs present).
row.proposed_rule: After asking / telling someone to do something (talabet min ...) the action is a bare present verb even in a past story, never the past: talabet min el-muwazzaf yiji, not aja.

rulings.why: Real correction; no bucket fits, so PROPOSE per GR-18.
Duplicate of D18: same illi slip; he first said اللي at 35:16 and repeated it reading back at 38:23; one row, the first (D18).

row.medi_said: شنو آآآ أكل؟ ... شنو فطور عندك؟

row.right: كمان نص ساعة = in half an hour
row.why: He read kamaan + time as 'more'; she said No and explained it means 'in / after' (28:44).

row.medi_said: اللي، آآآ جا، ... / الـ موافظ اللي يجي

row.english: I asked the employee to come

rulings.why: Real; first occurrence kept, D12 is its duplicate.
